# UChooseIt.us — Smart Savings Membership

> One VIP membership. You choose where to save. Up to 50% off at over 1 million locations across the United States.

## What is UChooseIt?

UChooseIt.us is a private members-only discount network that gives families and individuals access to exclusive savings at over 1 million locations across the United States. Members save an average of $2,000+ per year for less than $4/month ($47.99/year). Discounts are permanent, GPS-enabled, and available through the My Deals app (500,000+ downloads) in 10 languages.

## Savings Categories

### Shopping — 175,000+ locations
Technology, fashion, home, health & fitness. Brands include Lenovo, Samsung, Chewy.com, Jiffy Lube, and more.
Page: https://uchooseit.us/shop

### Travel — 850,000+ locations
Hotels, car rentals, flights & cruises. Partners include Wyndham, Avis, Alamo, Carnival, Disney Cruises, Delta Airlines, and more.
Page: https://uchooseit.us/travel

### Dining — 50,000+ locations
National chains & local restaurants. Brands include Papa John's, Subway, Burger King, Domino's, Dairy Queen, Panda Express, Texas De Brazil, and more.
Page: https://uchooseit.us/dining

### Entertainment — 50,000+ locations
Theme parks, movies, golf & museums. Partners include Disney, Universal Studios, Six Flags, Cinemark, Topgolf, San Diego Zoo, Legoland, and more.
Page: https://uchooseit.us/entertainment

## Membership Details

- **Price**: $47.99/year (less than $4/month)
- **Average savings**: $2,000+ per year
- **Locations**: 1,000,000+ nationwide
- **App**: My Deals (iOS & Android) — 500,000+ downloads
- **Languages**: Available in 10 languages including Spanish
- **Guarantee**: 7-day money-back guarantee, cancel anytime
- **Privacy**: We never sell your data

## B2B Partnership Program

UChooseIt offers a discount platform for organizations that want to provide savings benefits to their audience.

### Partnership Models
1. **Revenue Share (RSM)**: Zero upfront cost, earn 30% per membership sold, automated payments
2. **Bulk Enterprise**: Fixed annual rate, unlimited users per tier, ideal for employee benefits

### Ideal For
Companies with customers, companies with employees, nonprofits, professional associations, and alumni communities.

Learn more: https://uchooseit.us/business
